_note: Maps hash-named files in public/media to cases. Alt text describes what is visible, checked by eye on 2026-10-20.

items.alt: First page of the BME 2081C Ninetales soldering and testing guide, showing the green Ninetales circuit board with a white fox drawing in its silkscreen.
First page of the Arduino source: about twenty lines that read pin A1, begin serial at 9600 baud and delay 10 milliseconds.
A page of the Processing monitor source showing the threshold, beat interval and flash logic.

Background review page titled Brainstorming Artifacts with three hand-drawn, coloured-pencil concept sketches: an oversized insole in a flexible sock, a fluid shoe, and an insole with fluid-filled arch bladders.
Design review page with a table of six user needs, their design inputs and verification methods, including the 8 mm thickness, 10 percent growth and 150 N inputs.
Final report page describing the assembly and the prototype history from the V1 cardboard and foam proof of concept to V2 gel pads in compression sleeves.
Final report results table: three static tests and two impact tests marked insert unaffected, and impact number three marked insert slightly damaged but contained with slight leakage.
Page of the TENS literature review showing a systems diagram with human, mechanical, electrical, chemical and biological boxes connected by labelled arrows.
Red and white poster titled Systemic Analysis of TENS Devices to Guide Future Design Improvements, with a problem statement, a systems diagram, a handheld TENS unit, and wearable garment examples.
